questions: Have you been experiencing neck pain or stiffness?
Do you have any difficulty moving your head?
Have you had any recent injuries to your neck or upper back?
Do you have numbness or tingling in your arms?
Have you noticed any weakness in your arms or hands?
Have you noticed any twitching or flickering movements in your muscles?
Have you noticed any wasting or thinning of your muscles, particularly in your hands or shoulders?
How long have you been experiencing any symptoms?
Do you have any difficulty swallowing or changes in your voice?
Is there any family history of neurological conditions such as ALS or motor neuron disease?
Have you been told you have cataracts, especially at an early age?
Do you experience excessive daytime sleepiness or fatigue?
Have you had any heart rhythm problems or been told you have a heart block?
Do you have any difficulty with swallowing or gastrointestinal symptoms?
Have you noticed any droopiness of your eyelids or facial muscles?
Have you noticed your head pulling or tilting to one side?
Do you feel any tightness or pulling sensation in your neck or shoulder?
Has anyone commented that your head posture looks unusual?
Does the tightness or pulling worsen when you are stressed or fatigued?
Can you voluntarily correct your head position if asked?
Are you aware of any involuntary jerking or twitching movements happening that you cannot control?
Do these movements happen more when you are at rest or when you try to move?
Have you noticed these movements in specific parts of your body, like your arms, shoulders, or neck?
Do the movements ever wake you up from sleep?
Can the movements be stopped temporarily if you place a hand on the affected area?
Are the movements brief and quick, like a sudden jolt or shock?
Are the movements rhythmic like a beat, or irregular and unpredictable?
Do the movements affect both sides of your body equally, or are they worse on one side?
Do the movements happen more when you are trying to relax or when you are actively doing something?
Have you noticed any pattern to when the movements occur, such as in certain positions or activities?
Can you show me exactly where in your body the rhythmic movements occur?
When did you first notice these movements?
Are the movements always present or do they come and go?
Does anything make the movements better or worse?
Have you tried any medications that affected these movements?
orders: Examining for presence and characteristics of tremor (resting vs. postural vs. action)
Test for percussion myotonia of thenar eminence
Test for percussion myotonia of trapezius muscle
Test for grip myotonia (ask patient to grip and then release quickly)
Electromyography (EMG) of trapezius and upper limb muscles
